name: cartapnk
description: CartaPnk: menú digital para restaurantes. backend (API Express + PostgreSQL) + frontend (sitio estático servido por Nginx)

scripts.docker:dev: docker compose -p pnk-dev --env-file env/dev.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.docker:qa: docker compose -p pnk-qa --env-file env/qa.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.qa.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from pruebas
scripts.docker:qa:app: docker compose -p pnk-qa --env-file env/qa.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.qa.yml up --build -d back front db
scripts.docker:prod: docker compose -p pnk-prod --env-file env/prod.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build -d
scripts.docker:down:dev: docker compose -p pnk-dev --env-file env/dev.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml down
scripts.docker:down:qa: docker compose -p pnk-qa --env-file env/qa.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.qa.yml down -v
scripts.docker:down:prod: docker compose -p pnk-prod --env-file env/prod.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml down
